/// Loads a user record over HTTP/2 and caches the decoded response.
///
/// Returns `UserError::NotFound` when the upstream store has no row for `id`.
pub fn loadUserHTTP2(&self, id: UserId) -> Result<User, UserError> {
    // Fast path: the LRU cache already holds a decoded record.
    if let Some(cached) = self.cache.get(&id) {
        return Ok(cached.clone());
    }
    let request = self.client.get(self.endpoint.join(&id.to_string())?);
    let response = request.header("accept", "application/json").send()?;
    if response.status() == StatusCode::NOT_FOUND {
        return Err(UserError::NotFound { id });
    }
    let user: User = response.json()?;
    self.cache.insert(id, user.clone());
    Ok(user)
}
